transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... work sent me here. I guess I've been missing things. Forgetting to call people back when I'm supposed to, or... losing track of work orders. It's just piled up a bit, and they said I needed to get it sorted out or I might lose my chance at a promotion. So... that's why I'm here.
When did you first notice you were having trouble remembering things like calls and work orders?

I suppose... maybe 11 months ago. It got noticeably worse then, anyway. We got a new management company and they... well, they switched the whole department over to digital work orders. And they want stricter documentation for everything now. So... yeah. About 11 months.
Are you having trouble remembering things outside of work as well?
I don't... not really. I mean, home is just home. Nobody's checking up on my paperwork there, so... I haven't really noticed anything. Just the usual, I guess.
Are you having any difficulty performing daily tasks or routines outside of work?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I just do the same things I always do. It's fine.
Have you been feeling confused lately?
No... not confused. I mean, I know what I'm doing. It's just... no, I don't think so.
Do you find yourself having trouble organizing your tasks or paperwork at work?
Not really. I mean... I do maintenance. There isn't a whole lot of paperwork to organize anyway. I just get my work orders and go fix things, so... no.
Do you think you would remember those work orders and calls if someone reminded you about them?
I don't know... maybe? If someone reminded me, I guess I'd remember. But usually, I just... I don't know, I just try to handle it myself.
Do you think you're paying less attention to your work orders and calls than you used to?
I don't really know. I haven't... I don't really track that sort of thing. I just look at the ticket and try to get the job done. So... I'm not sure if it's any different now.
Do you feel like you're putting in the same amount of effort to remember work orders and calls as you used to?
I... I guess so. I mean, I try to. I just go to work and do what I'm supposed to do. I don't really sit around thinking about how hard I'm trying.
Do you feel like you're forgetting work orders and calls because you're not trying hard enough to remember them?
I don't think it's about not trying. I just... I don't know why it happens. I go in and do my job. I'm not doing it on purpose.
Do you think you would remember your work orders and calls if it meant getting that promotion at work?
I... I really couldn't say. I'm already trying to do my job, so... I don't know if a promotion would change anything. I haven't really thought about it.
Do you think you could remember your work orders and calls if you really needed to?
I don't... I don't know. I mean, I guess I always need to. It's my job. I just... I don't know if trying harder would even do anything.
Do you think you're forgetting work orders and calls because you're just not that interested in your job?
I don't think so. I mean... it's just work. I don't hate it or anything. I just... I don't really know why it happens.
Do you think you could remember your work orders and calls if someone was constantly supervising you and making sure you stayed on task?
I'm... not really sure. I usually work on my own, so nobody's really watching over my shoulder like that. I just... I don't know if it would make a difference.
Do you think you would forget work orders and calls if you were doing something that really had your attention?
I don't know... maybe? I guess if I was really focused on it, I might remember better. But... I'm not sure. It's hard to say.
Do you think you would forget things at work even if you were doing a task that you really enjoyed?
I'm not sure. I just... I do maintenance, so it's not really about enjoying it. I don't know if it would happen anyway. I couldn't tell you.
Do you think your forgetfulness at work is because you're not putting enough mental effort into remembering things?
I don't know. I mean... I feel like I try to remember things. It just... I don't really know why it happens. I couldn't say if it's about effort.
Do you think your forgetfulness at work would improve if you were to make a conscious effort to write down all your work orders and calls?
I guess it might... I don't really know. I haven't... I haven't really tried doing that. So I couldn't say for sure.
Do you think you would forget work orders and calls if you were able to give them your full attention?
I don't know. Maybe. I just... I feel like I'm paying attention, but things still slip my mind. I can't really say if it would make a difference.
Do you think your mind wanders a lot when you're supposed to be remembering work orders and calls?
I'm not sure. I mean... I don't really notice if it does. It's hard to say.
